description: Angular component for configuring trace collection settings in a UI, including trace targets, enable/disable options, and selection configurations.

classes.name: TraceConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing trace configuration UI.

methods.name: advancedConfigTraces
methods.description: Returns list of trace keys with additional configuration options.

methods.name: traceEnableConfigs
methods.description: Returns enable configurations for a given trace.

methods.name: traceSelectionConfigs
methods.description: Returns selection configurations for a given trace.

methods.name: someTraces
methods.description: Determines if any traces are enabled but not running.

methods.name: changeRunTrace
methods.description: Enables or disables a trace and updates related configs.

methods.name: changeTraceCollectionConfig
methods.description: Updates trace run state based on enable configs.
